name: GTM lightning PMF hunt
outcome: A single beachhead job produces external job-activations and unforced pull signals, with any public-live amplification gated by H1 and claim-safe review.

verifier.green_means: Scoreboard shows source-bound external J1/J2 or CAO rows for one segment×job cell; T0 vanity is not used as success; any live publish has guardian + H1 evidence.

stop.success: PMF checker accepts concentration evidence for one cell, or an explicit RED narrow/kill decision is recorded.

nodes.name: Select beachhead job and segment
nodes.outcome: One segment and one recurring job are pre-registered with kill clocks and demotion rules.

contract.goal: Name one segment×job cell, a 14-day kill rule, and what counts as J1 vs vanity.

verifier.green_means: Segment, job, J1 definition, and 14-day RED rule are explicit and claim-safe.

stop.success: PMF checker accepts the beachhead packet.

nodes.name: Run product try-path proof sprint
nodes.outcome: Install pin and one golden job path are honest and runnable without founder heroics.

contract.goal: Make the advertised install path match shipped surface and document the golden job path.

verifier.green_means: Doctor HEALTHY and README pin notes match available commands.

stop.success: Activation reviewer accepts the try-path packet.

nodes.name: Run controlled pilot contacts
nodes.outcome: 15–30 named external contacts receive a map/starter for the beachhead job; reactions are logged as external demand rows.

contract.goal: Personal outreach only; log J1/J2/pull/WTP with source refs; never count dogfood as external.

verifier.green_means: Every external row has source_refs; dogfood isolated; concentration or 14-day RED is decided.

stop.success: Pilot packet accepted or RED kill recorded.

nodes.name: Approve public-live wave (H1)
nodes.outcome: Chairman approves a specific claim-safe artifact set for public-live amplification after pilot GREEN.

nodes.name: Run evidence-backed amplification wave
nodes.outcome: A time-boxed wave amplifies the proven beachhead path without inventing verified-corpus claims.

contract.goal: Publish only guardian-cleared artifacts; measure J1 conversion, not T0 vanity alone.

verifier.green_means: Every live asset matches cleared digests; no claim denylist breach; post-wave demand rows updated.
